info.name: SnapURL API — auth + link CRUD/PATCH
info.description: Run against the local staging stack (pnpm staging:up) with `bash qa/postman/run.sh` — it starts qa/postman/mail-sink.mjs (loopback-only reader of the staging mail outbox, needed by the team-invitation folder) and runs `npx -y newman@6 run qa/postman/snapurl.postman_collection.json -e qa/postman/local.postman_environment.json`. Every request carries pm.test assertions on status and body. No secrets: the account and link are created fresh per run.

item.name: Team invitations (#668)
item.description: Owner invites → token read from the staging mail outbox via qa/postman/mail-sink.mjs (run through qa/postman/run.sh) → invitee accepts → owner sees them active with the role; every refusal code; Viewer role enforced; workspace switcher + refresh hint. already_member is not reachable through the public API (one membership row per workspace+email) and is covered by apps/api/src/auth/invite-accept.integration.test.ts.

Accept with an unknown token is invite_invalid

exec: pm.test("response names neither address", () => { const t = pm.response.text().toLowerCase(); pm.expect(t).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("inv_invitee_email")); pm.expect(t).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("inv_stranger_email")); });

item.name: Mail sink: read the invitee's verification token
Invitee verifies their email
Invitee accepts: session in the owner's workspace as Viewer

exec: const claims = (t) => { let p = t.split(".")[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"); while (p.length % 4) p += "="; return JSON.parse(require("atob")(p)); };
pm.test("access token bound to it", () => { const c = claims(b.accessToken); pm.expect(c.wid).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("inv_owner_wid")); pm.expect(c.role).to.eql("viewer"); });

item.name: Re-using the accepted token is invite_used
Owner's GET /members shows the invitee active as Viewer
Joined session reads the owner's workspace
GET /auth/me reports the Viewer role in the joined workspace
Viewer cannot create a link (role enforced)
Viewer cannot invite (role enforced)
Viewer can read the workspace's members
Switcher lists both workspaces, current = joined

exec: pm.test("own workspace as owner, not current", () => { pm.expect(own.role).to.eql("owner"); pm.expect(own.current).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("joined workspace as viewer, current", () => { pm.expect(joined.role).to.eql("viewer"); pm.expect(joined.current).to.eql(true); });

Team timestamps (#669)
item.description: Pins the data the /team page renders times from: invitedAt on a pending member (the page used to hard-code 'Invited 2 days ago'), and ISO `at` on audit entries. The UI formatting itself is covered by e2e/journeys/j16-team-display.spec.ts.

item.name: Register owner
Owner invites a teammate

exec: pm.test("invite response carries invitedAt = now (ISO)", () => { pm.expect(b.invitedAt).to.be.a("string").and.match(ISO); pm.expect(Math.abs(Date.now() - new Date(b.invitedAt).getTime())).to.be.below(60000); });
pm.test("not yet active so lastActive is null", () => pm.expect(b.lastActive).to.eql(null));

item.name: GET /members: pending row has invitedAt ~ now, active row has none

exec: pm.test("pending invitedAt is the real send time, not a stale value", () => { pm.expect(pending.invitedAt).to.match(ISO); pm.expect(Math.abs(Date.now() - new Date(pending.invitedAt).getTime())).to.be.below(60000); });
pm.test("active member has invitedAt null", () => pm.expect(owner.invitedAt).to.eql(null));

item.name: GET /audit: entries carry an ISO timestamp the UI can format

exec: pm.test("every entry.at is ISO-8601", () => rows.forEach((a) => pm.expect(a.at).to.match(ISO)));
// pastIso/futureIso are fixed instants so assertions are exact.
